lines.t: You were made from Him, not only for Him
Heart of His heart, breath of His breath
Pulled from the dark and the endless scrolling
“Loose every chain, fall into My rest”
Stop climbing that cold glass mountain “trust”
Stop chasing that mirage you call “enough”
Look to your side, He’s already with you
Love in His eyes, His hand lifting you up
We are one in You, YahuShua
808s under our feet, heaven over our head
Ethereal lights, trap drums colliding
Into the prophet’s reward, into Your fullness and rest
We are one in You, YahuShua
Your life in our veins, Your fire in our chest
Children of God, predestined in the Beloved
Lost in Your oneness, we live, we’re blessed
[Verse 2]
“Beloved, you are accepted because of Me
I am your covering, I am enough
Fall into Me like a drop into the ocean
Let every boundary break in My love”
Grab hold with your heart, not your weary flesh
Let every burden melt into the floor
Hear His whisper in the reverb and the silence
One breath, one body, forevermore
We are one in You, YahuShua
808s under our feet, heaven over our head
Ethereal lights, trap drums colliding
Into the prophet’s reward, into Your fullness and rest
We are one in You, YahuShua
Your life in our veins, Your fire in our chest
Children of God, predestined in the Beloved
Draw us in oneness, we’re found, we’re blessed
